common.tagline: Get tipped by your fans easily with PromptPay
common.demoBanner: 🚧 This site is currently in demo mode — please verify before using with real money

landing.heroTitle: Let your fans support you in a few clicks
landing.heroSubtitle: Create your page, share the link, and receive tips via PromptPay along with kind messages.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up and pick your link, e.g. tiptang.app/en/yourname
landing.step2Desc: Add it to your bio, stream, or social profiles
landing.step3Desc: Fans scan PromptPay, pay, and leave you a message
landing.feature1: No fees — you keep every baht
landing.feature2: Works with PromptPay across all banks
landing.feature3: Confirm slips yourself, stay in control

auth.usernameHint: a-z, 0-9, _ only. This becomes your link.
auth.errorEmailTaken: This email is already in use
auth.errorUsernameTaken: This link name is already taken
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.forgotDesc: Enter your registered email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If that email exists, we've sent a reset link. Please check your inbox (and spam folder).
auth.resetSuccess: Password updated! You can now log in.
auth.resetInvalid: This link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.

profile.showPublic: Show my message on the profile
profile.scanHint: Open your banking app, scan the QR, transfer the amount, then upload the slip.
profile.saveQrHint: On mobile: save the QR, then in your banking app choose "scan from gallery/photo".
profile.noSupporters: No supporters yet — be the first!
profile.notConfigured: This creator hasn't set up PromptPay yet

tipSuccess.title: Tip sent! 🎉
tipSuccess.message: Thank you for your support! Your message will appear on the profile once the creator confirms your slip.
tipSuccess.messageAuto: Thank you for your support! Your slip was auto-verified and your message is already live on the profile.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noTips: No tips yet. Share your link with your fans!
dashboard.setupPromptpayWarning: You haven't set up PromptPay yet — go to settings so fans can tip you.
dashboard.obsDesc: Add this URL as a Browser Source in OBS — when a tip comes in and you confirm it, an alert card pops up on your stream automatically.
dashboard.obsUrlLabel: Overlay URL (keep secret — don't show it on stream)
dashboard.obsHint: OBS → Sources → + → Browser → paste URL → width 800, height 300 (background is transparent automatically)
dashboard.obsGoalToggleHint: Turn on to use a live progress bar as its own OBS source.
dashboard.obsGoalUrlLabel: Goal-bar URL (a live progress bar for your stream)
dashboard.obsGoalHint: Add as a second Browser Source (width 700, height 140). Shows only when you've set a goal in Settings; updates live as tips are confirmed.
dashboard.obsGoalEmpty: Set a goal in Settings to see the bar here.
dashboard.obsTtsHint: Speaks the supporter's name + amount + message when an alert pops (Thai voice).
dashboard.obsVideoHint: MP4 / WebM, max 10MB — image + sound in one file
dashboard.obsVideoNote: If you add a video, it replaces the image + sound (video has its own audio).

settings.title: Profile settings
settings.bioPlaceholder: Tell people a bit about you...
settings.promptpayHint: 10-digit phone or 13-digit national ID — used only to generate the QR, never shown publicly.
settings.autoConfirmHint: Show tips on your profile immediately without clicking Confirm. Turn this on only if you check your bank yourself — it does not verify slips, so a fake slip would show up too.
settings.errorUsernameTaken: This link name is already taken
settings.cropTitle: Adjust image — drag/zoom to choose what shows
settings.goalHint: Shows a progress bar on your profile. Progress = your confirmed tips total. Leave blank or 0 to hide.
settings.socialHint: Paste the full URL (starting with https://). Empty ones are hidden.

errors.badType: Only images are allowed (JPG, PNG, WebP)

errors.duplicateSlip: This slip has already been used. Please use a new transfer slip.
